name: Iceland (Reykjavík)
kernel_gaps: Credit spent across several taxes and two spouses in a statutory order with a 22/31 conversion at the last step (67. gr. A; useCredit, coupleCredits)
Partial transfer of tax-band room between spouses with a cap (66. gr. 1. mgr. 4. tölul.; bandShift): not splitting, not transferAllowance
Flat-amount levies with an all-or-nothing income floor and an age window (útvarpsgjald, Framkvæmdasjóður aldraðra; levyDue); Contribution is rate-based
Taper.WellFormed requires round = .down; RSK rounds barnabætur reductions half up, so the taper theorems were proved locally
Benefit minimum per recipient that lapses (5.000 kr. per parent) and halving between parents (shared residence)
Withholding with decimals rounded once (staðgreiðsla), not Table.perPeriod

headline: Iceland's 2025 income tax in Lean reproduces all 48 OECD Taxing Wages lines and RSK's own barnabætur (26/26) and withholding (13/14) calculators; one króna above 2,617,618 ISK triggers 36,814 ISK of flat levies, barnabætur withdrawal stacks to 54 % marginal rates for families with young children, parents living apart with shared residence get up to 566,040 ISK a year more barnabætur than a couple, and two cross-references in the tax laws point to the wrong paragraph.
